q: Agar koi kisi ko jaan boojh kar maar de to uski kya saza hai, aur kya maqtool ke waris usay maaf kar sakte hain?
en: What is the punishment for someone who intentionally kills another person, and can the heirs of the maqtool (the deceased) grant them forgiveness?

q: Mere shohar ne mujh se ijazat liye baghair doosri shadi kar li hai. Kya main uske khilaf koi karwai kar sakti hoon?
en: My husband has entered into a second marriage without obtaining my consent. Am I entitled to initiate any legal proceedings against him?

q: Shohar ne zubani teen dafa talaq keh di lekin chairman union council ko koi notice nahi bheja. Kya talaq mukammal ho gayi?
en: The husband pronounced talaq (divorce) orally on three occasions, but no notice was served to the Chairman of the Union Council. Is the talaq (divorce) complete?

q: Biwi khula lene ke liye family court mein kya karti hai, aur kya usay haq mehr wapas karna parta hai?
en: What procedure does a wife follow in the Family Court to obtain a khula (divorce initiated by the wife), and is she required to refund the haq mehr (dower)?

q: Baap bachon ka kharcha nahi de raha. Maa unki taraf se kaunsa case kar sakti hai aur kya court foran kuch kharcha dilwa sakti hai?
en: The father is not providing maintenance for the children. What legal action can the mother initiate on their behalf, and can the court grant interim maintenance immediately?

q: Mujhe dar hai ke mere khilaf jhooti FIR darj ho jayegi. Kya giraftari se pehle hi court se zamanat mil sakti hai?
en: I am concerned that a false FIR (First Information Report) may be registered against me. Is it possible to obtain pre-arrest bail from the court?

q: Kisi ne meri behan ki tasveeren edit kar ke gandi bana di aur Facebook par daal di hain. Is ki kya saza hai?
en: Someone has edited my sister's pictures to make them obscene and uploaded them on Facebook. What is the punishment for this?

q: Ek larka mujhe har roz naye naye accounts se messages bhejta hai, follow karta hai aur dhamkiyan deta hai. Qanoon mein iske liye kya hai?
en: A boy is sending me messages from new accounts every day, following me, and issuing threats. What is the provision in the law for this?

q: Punjab mein kiraya-nama register karwana zaroori hai? Agar register na ho to kya hoga?
en: Is it mandatory to register the tenancy agreement in Punjab? What are the legal consequences if it is not registered?

q: Mere ghar par kisi ne zabardasti qabza kar liya hai. Court se kaise wapis milega aur kitne arse ke andar case karna zaroori hai?
en: Someone has forcibly occupied my property. How can I recover possession through the court, and what is the limitation period for filing a case?

q: Mere saath wali zameen ka malik usay chupke se kisi aur ko bech raha hai. Main parosi hoon, kya pehle khareedne ka mera haq banta hai?
en: The owner of the adjacent land is secretly selling it to someone else. As a neighbor, do I have the right of first refusal?

q: Civil judge ke ek order ke khilaf appeal nahi ho sakti. Kya High Court mein revision ho sakti hai aur kin wajohat par?
en: An appeal cannot be filed against an order of the Civil Judge. Is a revision maintainable in the High Court, and on what grounds?

q: Hamari private company ne do saal se annual return file nahi kiya. Directors par kya jurmana ho sakta hai?
en: Our private company has failed to file its annual returns for the past two years. What penalties may be imposed on the directors?

q: Hamari partnership firm kabhi register nahi hui. Ab ek partner hissa nahi de raha, kya hum us par case kar sakte hain?
en: Our partnership firm was never registered. Now, one of the partners is refusing to share his portion; can we file a case against him?

q: Income tax return der se jama karwane par kitna penalty lagta hai?
en: What is the penalty for the late filing of an income tax return?

q: Kya Income Tax Ordinance 1979 abhi bhi lagu hai ya naya qanoon aa chuka hai?
en: Is the Income Tax Ordinance 1979 still in force, or has a new law been enacted?

q: Punjab mein sarkari mulazim ko inquiry ke baghair naukri se nikala ja sakta hai? Iska tareeqa kya hai?
en: Can a government servant in Punjab be dismissed from service without an inquiry? What is the procedure for the same?

q: Punjab mein bachon se kaam karwana ab kis qanoon ke tehat jurm hai, aur kam se kam umar kya rakhi gayi hai?
en: Under which law is child labor currently a criminal offense in Punjab, and what is the minimum age prescribed for employment?

q: Islamabad mein agar walidain apni pandrah saal ki beti ki shadi kar dein to unhein kya saza ho sakti hai?
en: What is the punishment for parents in Islamabad who marry off their fifteen-year-old daughter?

q: Kya Hindu shadi ki registration ab qanoonan zaroori hai aur kahan hoti hai?
en: Is the registration of a Hindu marriage now a legal requirement, and where does it take place?

q: Abbu ke inteqal ke baad bank account ke paise nikalne ke liye waris certificate NADRA se kaise banwayein?
en: How can a succession certificate (waris certificate) be obtained from NADRA for the purpose of withdrawing funds from a bank account following the demise of the father?

q: Shohar maarta peet-ta hai aur ghar se nikalne ki dhamki deta hai. Punjab mein kya court mujhe ghar mein rehne ka order de sakti hai?
en: The husband subjects me to physical violence and threatens to evict me from the house. Can the court in Punjab grant me an order for residence in the house?

q: Office mein boss ghalat baatein karta hai. Harassment ki shikayat kahan aur kaise ki jati hai?
en: The boss makes inappropriate remarks at the office. Where and how can a complaint of harassment be lodged?

q: Lahore se khareeda hua fridge do hafte mein kharab ho gaya aur dukandar badalne se inkar kar raha hai. Kya company zimmedar hai?
en: The refrigerator purchased from Lahore became defective within two weeks, and the dealer is refusing to replace it. Is the company liable?

q: Agar samne wala contract tor de to mujhe kitna harjana mil sakta hai?
en: In the event of a breach of contract by the opposing party, what amount of damages am I entitled to claim?

q: Walid sahib ne zubani hiba kar ke zameen mere naam ki thi, registry nahi hui. Kya hiba phir bhi sahih hai?
en: The father gifted the land to me through oral hiba (gift), but the registry was not executed. Is the hiba still valid?

q: Kya Pakistan ke har shehri ko sarkari maloomat hasil karne ka haq aain ne diya hai?
en: Does the Constitution grant every citizen of Pakistan the right to access official information?

q: Ek hi jurm par kisi ko do dafa muqadma chala kar saza di ja sakti hai?
en: Can a person be tried and punished twice for the same offense?

q: President ka jaari kiya hua ordinance kitne din tak lagu rehta hai agar parliament usay pass na kare?
en: For what duration does an ordinance issued by the President remain in force if it is not passed by the Parliament?

q: Bank ka qarza wapis na karne par bank kis court mein case karta hai?
en: In which court does a bank file a case for non-repayment of a loan?

q: Sales tax mein registration kab lazmi ho jati hai?
en: At what point does registration under sales tax become mandatory?

q: Factory mein kaam karte hue mazdoor ka haath machine mein aa gaya. Muawza kaun dega aur kis qanoon ke tehat?
en: While working in a factory, a laborer's hand got caught in a machine. Who shall be liable to pay compensation, and under what law?

q: Gari tez chalate hue lapar wahi se kisi ki maut ho jaye to driver ko kya saza hoti hai?
en: What is the punishment for a driver in the event of a death caused by rash and negligent driving?

q: Kisi ne mujhe udhaar wapis karne ke liye cheque diya jo bounce ho gaya. Kya main police case kar sakta hoon?
en: A person issued a cheque to me for the repayment of a loan, which has subsequently bounced. Am I entitled to initiate criminal proceedings against them?

q: Court mein muqadma chal raha hai aur doosri party ghar kisi aur ko bech rahi hai. Isay kaise rokein?
en: A lawsuit is pending in court, and the opposing party is attempting to sell the property to a third party. How can this be restrained?

q: قتل کے مقدمے میں ملزم کو ضمانت کن حالات میں مل سکتی ہے؟
en: Under what circumstances can a person be granted bail in a murder case?

q: بیوی شوہر سے خلع کیسے لے سکتی ہے اور کیا اسے حق مہر واپس کرنا پڑتا ہے؟
en: How can a wife obtain a khula (divorce initiated by the wife) from her husband, and is she required to return the haq mehr (dower)?

q: طلاق کے بعد بچوں کی تحویل کس کو ملتی ہے اور عدالت فیصلہ کرتے وقت کن باتوں کو دیکھتی ہے؟
en: Who is entitled to the custody of the children after a divorce, and what factors does the court take into consideration while passing a decree?

q: کیا کسی نابالغ کے ساتھ کیا گیا معاہدہ قانونی طور پر نافذ ہو سکتا ہے؟
en: Can an agreement entered into with a minor be legally enforceable?

q: کیا سول عدالت ہر قسم کا دیوانی مقدمہ سن سکتی ہے یا کچھ مقدمات اس کے دائرہ اختیار سے باہر ہیں؟
en: Does the Civil Court have the jurisdiction to hear all types of civil suits, or are certain suits outside its jurisdiction?

q: کراچی میں مالک مکان کرایہ دار کو کن وجوہات کی بنا پر مکان خالی کروا سکتا ہے؟
en: On what grounds can a landlord evict a tenant from a premises in Karachi?

q: غیرت کے نام پر قتل میں اگر مقتول کے ورثاء قاتل کو معاف کر دیں تو کیا وہ سزا سے بچ جاتا ہے؟
en: In a case of murder committed in the name of 'ghairat' (honor), if the heirs of the deceased forgive the murderer, does the murderer escape from punishment?

q: کسی دوسرے کے کمپیوٹر یا ای میل اکاؤنٹ میں اجازت کے بغیر داخل ہونا کیا جرم ہے؟
en: What is the offense of accessing someone else's computer or email account without authorization?

q: کسی سرکاری محکمے کے غیر قانونی حکم کے خلاف ہائی کورٹ سے کیسے رجوع کیا جا سکتا ہے؟
en: How can a writ petition be filed in the High Court against an illegal order issued by a government department?

q: پولیس کسی کو گرفتار کرے تو اسے کتنے گھنٹوں کے اندر مجسٹریٹ کے سامنے پیش کرنا ضروری ہے؟
en: Within how many hours must the police produce an arrested person before a Magistrate?

q: کیا بچوں کو مفت تعلیم دینا ریاست کی آئینی ذمہ داری ہے؟
en: Is it the constitutional responsibility of the State to provide free education to children?

q: بینک سے لیا گیا قرض واپس نہ کرنے پر بینک کس عدالت میں مقدمہ دائر کرتا ہے؟
en: In which court does a bank file a suit for the recovery of a loan not repaid?

q: سندھ میں کم عمر بچی کی شادی کروانے پر کس کس کو سزا ہو سکتی ہے؟
en: Who can be punished for the solemnization of marriage of a minor girl in Sindh?

q: شوہر کو دوسری شادی کرنے کے لیے کس سے اجازت لینا ضروری ہے؟
en: From whom is it mandatory to obtain permission for a husband to solemnize a second marriage?

q: زمین کی فروخت پر ہمسایہ اپنا حق شفعہ کیسے استعمال کرتا ہے؟
en: How does a neighbor exercise their right of Shufa (pre-emptive right) in the sale of land?

q: مکان کی خرید و فروخت کی دستاویز کی رجسٹریشن لازمی ہے یا صرف اسٹامپ پیپر کافی ہے؟
en: Is the registration of the property sale deed mandatory, or is a stamp paper sufficient?

q: انٹرنیٹ پر کسی کو بار بار ہراساں کرنے، پیچھا کرنے اور دھمکیاں دینے کی کیا سزا ہے؟
en: What is the punishment for repeated harassment, stalking, and issuing threats over the internet?

q: انشورنس کمپنی کلیم کی ادائیگی میں مہینوں کی تاخیر کرے تو قانون کیا کہتا ہے؟
en: What does the law provide in the event of a delay of several months by an insurance company in the payment of a claim?

q: کمپنی کے اقلیتی حصص یافتگان اکثریت کی زیادتی کے خلاف کہاں درخواست دے سکتے ہیں؟
en: Where can the minority shareholders of the company file an application against the oppression of the majority?

q: کیا کمپنیز آرڈیننس 1984 اب بھی نافذ ہے؟
en: Is the Companies Ordinance, 1984, still in force?

q: کسی کو جان سے مارنے یا گھر جلانے کی دھمکی دینا کیا جرم ہے؟
en: What is the offense of threatening to kill someone or set fire to a house?

q: معاہدہ توڑنے پر دوسرے فریق کو کتنا ہرجانہ مل سکتا ہے؟
en: What amount of damages can be claimed by the other party for breach of contract?

q: اگر ملزم پولیس کے سامنے جرم کا اعتراف کرے تو کیا یہ اعتراف عدالت میں قابل قبول ہے؟
en: If the accused confesses to the offense before the police, is such a confession admissible in court?

q: قرض یا مالی لین دین کی تحریر پر کتنے گواہ ہونے چاہئیں؟
en: How many witnesses are required for a written instrument of loan or financial transaction?

q: کیا واٹس ایپ پیغامات اور آڈیو ریکارڈنگ عدالت میں بطور ثبوت پیش کی جا سکتی ہیں؟
en: Can WhatsApp messages and audio recordings be produced as evidence before the court?

q: اسلام آباد میں گھریلو تشدد کا شکار خاتون کے تحفظ کے لیے عدالت کون سے احکامات جاری کر سکتی ہے؟
en: What orders can the court issue for the protection of a woman victim of domestic violence in Islamabad?

q: وفاقی سرکاری ملازم کی ریٹائرمنٹ کی عمر کیا ہے؟
en: What is the age of retirement for a federal government servant?

q: خیبر پختونخوا میں کسی سرکاری محکمے سے معلومات کیسے مانگی جاتی ہیں اور جواب کتنے دن میں ملنا چاہیے؟
en: What is the procedure for requesting information from a government department in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, and within what timeframe is the response required to be provided?

q: خواجہ سرا افراد کو اپنی شناخت خود طے کرنے کا حق کس قانون نے دیا ہے؟
en: Under which law do Khawaja Sira individuals have the right to determine their own identity?

q: اخبار کی جھوٹی خبر سے ہونے والی بدنامی پر عدالت اخبار کو کیا حکم دے سکتی ہے؟
en: What order can the court pass against a newspaper for defamation caused by a false news report?

q: ثالث کا فیصلہ کن بنیادوں پر عدالت سے کالعدم کروایا جا سکتا ہے؟
en: Can the decision of the arbitrator be declared null and void by the court on what grounds?

q: انکم ٹیکس ریٹرن جمع کروانا کن لوگوں پر لازمی ہے، چاہے ان کی آمدنی قابل ٹیکس حد سے کم ہو؟
en: On which persons is it mandatory to file an income tax return, even if their income is below the taxable limit?

q: کیا عوامی نمائندگی ایکٹ 1976 منسوخ ہو چکا ہے؟ اب انتخابات کس قانون کے تحت ہوتے ہیں؟
en: Has the Representation of the People Act 1976 been repealed? Under which law are elections now conducted?

q: پنجاب میں سرکاری ملازم کے خلاف محکمانہ کارروائی اور انکوائری کا طریقہ کار کیا ہے؟
en: What is the procedure for departmental proceedings and inquiry against a government servant in Punjab?

q: اگر کوئی شخص دستاویز پر اپنے دستخط سے انکار کر دے تو عدالت میں انہیں کیسے ثابت کیا جاتا ہے؟
en: In the event that a person denies their signature on a document, how is it proved in court?

q: Section 22-A CrPC ke tehat Justice of Peace kya kar sakta hai?
en: What are the powers of the Justice of the Peace under Section 22-A CrPC?

q: تعزیرات پاکستان کی دفعہ 302 کیا کہتی ہے؟
en: What does Section 302 of the Pakistan Penal Code provide?

q: MFLO ki section 7 kya kehti hai?
en: What does Section 7 of the MFLO provide?
